title: 5xx double-record — failure e success no mesmo request
description: httpHandler.ts:193-246: resposta 5xx chama recordFailure e depois recordSuccess no upSock.on('end'). Ban transitório é desfeito e successes++ em request que falhou. Score corrompido. Fix: set requestFailed=true no 5xx branch, ou skip recordSuccess quando um foi visto.
notes: Implemented in src/proxy/httpHandler.ts: upstream 5xx remains classified as failure through response end; no recordSuccess is issued and request metrics report success=false. Added an integration regression in src/__tests__/proxy.test.ts that sends a real HTTP request through the proxy to a local target returning 503 and asserts aggregate errors increase by one while successes remain unchanged. Verified: npx tsx --test --test-name-pattern=records upstream 5xx src/__tests__/proxy.test.ts (1 pass); npx tsx --test src/__tests__/proxy.test.ts (9 pass). Local HTTP 503 integration served as smoke scenario; target response completed and health counters matched.
close_reason: Verified 5xx response records failure without a health success. Added integration regression; focused test passes and proxy suite passes 9/9.

title: transfer-encoding nao filtrado — response desync risk
description: responseParser.ts nao remove transfer-encoding (hop-by-hop per RFC 2616 13.5.1) nem em respostas upstream nem em requests do client. Chunked framing forwarded verbatim para client; chunked upload forwarded com body bytes raw para upstream. Response desync / keep-alive corruption. Fix: adicionar transfer-encoding ao HOP_BY_HOP em ambos os paths.
notes:
Added transfer-encoding to HOP_BY_HOP; STRIPPED_REQUEST_HEADERS spreads HOP_BY_HOP and the request-forwarding loop filters that set. Added regression assertions for request-filter membership and that parseResponseHeaders omits Transfer-Encoding. Verified: npx tsx --test src/__tests__/responseParser.test.ts src/__tests__/proxy.test.ts (21 pass, 0 fail).
Framing correction: client chunked request bodies are decoded by Node IncomingMessage, re-chunked on the upstream HTTP hop, and terminated with 0\r\n\r\n; fixed-length request bodies retain their Content-Length framing. Upstream chunked responses are decoded before writing to ServerResponse, which applies client-hop framing; Transfer-Encoding and conflicting Content-Length are not forwarded. Deterministic local proxy integration verifies chunked upload body and target Transfer-Encoding, fixed-length body, and intact chunked upstream response. Verified: npx tsx --test src/__tests__/proxy.test.ts src/__tests__/responseParser.test.ts (26 pass, 0 fail); npm run build (pass).
No-body metadata edge: HEAD responses and 204/304 statuses are handled as bodyless before chunked decoding, regardless of Transfer-Encoding: chunked metadata. Body bytes present with headers or arriving later are ignored; the proxy does not wait for a terminal chunk, avoiding false 502 responses. Regression uses deterministic raw local upstream responses with chunked metadata and no body for HEAD 200, GET 204, and GET 304; all pass with empty client bodies. Verified: npx tsx --test src/__tests__/proxy.test.ts src/__tests__/responseParser.test.ts (27 passed, 0 failed).
close_reason: Per-hop framing and HTTP no-body response semantics verified by local integration tests
